agent_instructions: All files in this library are static and freely downloadable with no authentication. Fetch this manifest, then GET each file's path relative to the site root. Verify each download against the sha256 field. Materials are CC BY 4.0; site and engine source is MIT at https://github.com/tangison/oryx-safeman-ecosystem. The live examination question bank is deliberately not published.
